dedupe_keys.name: arlington county virginia sidewalk inventory with condition ratings

description: Arlington County publishes an inventory of sidewalk segments with condition ratings: the layer records the type and width of each sidewalk, its failures and failure category, the road it runs along, obstructions, a condition index and rating category, the maintenance jurisdiction and segment length. Coverage: Arlington County, Virginia; the FeatureServer layer returned 13,666 polyline segments on 2026-09-26. Access: free ArcGIS feature service with CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON, KML and file geodatabase downloads, mirrored on the Virginia Open Data Portal (record modified 2 September 2026). Licence: none stated on the portal record. Caveats: inspection dates and the rating scale are not documented in the portal record, and the licence should be confirmed with the county before redistribution. Simulation uses: sidewalk maintenance prioritisation, accessible routing and pedestrian network models for a dense suburban county. Related records: the Washington DC sidewalk condition assessment and Project Sidewalk accessibility labels.
